name: Demone
ability: You start knowing which Demon is in play. If there are 3 Demons in-play, good wins.
firstNightReminder: Wake the Demone and tell them which Demon is in play.

name: Minion
ability: If you are executed, a Townsfolk gains a not-in-play minion ability & changes alignment [-1 Minion]
otherNightReminder: If executed today, wake and turn a Townsfolk player into a minion opposite their original alignment.

name: Not-an-outsider
ability: You start knowing 3 true statements. 1 of them, if said publicly, will cause you to join the losing team even if dead.
firstNightReminder: Wake the player and tell them 3 true statements.

name: Evil
ability: Each night, choose 2 players; learn how many are evil. You must choose new players each night.
firstNightReminder: Wake Evil and have them point to two players. Tell them how many are evil.
otherNightReminder: Wake Evil and have them point to two new players. Tell them how many are evil.

name: A Character
ability: You think you are a good character not-on-script & might have their ability. Each night you might become a good character not-on-script.
firstNightReminder: Wake player if the off script character wakes
otherNightReminder: Wake player if the off script character wakes

name: Poisioned
ability: Each night*, choose an alive player; either you are they are poisioned till dusk. You learn their alignment.
otherNightReminder: Wake Poisioned and have them select a player. Mark a player as poisioned, then tell Poisioned the selected players alignment.

name: Townsfolk
ability: Each day, you may visit the storyteller to learn if you become a townsfolk.

name: Storyteller
ability: Each day you may visit the storyteller & choose the outcome of the next "might" ability.

name: Hard Claiming
ability: Once per game, during thet day, publicly choose a character, if that character dies tonight, good wins.
otherNightReminder: If the chosen player dies, good wins.

name: Outsider
ability: If the demon kills you, the Storyteller will flash the Grimoire at you but with characters out of order.
otherNightReminder: If killed by the demon, flash the grim at the player.

name: Executed
ability: If you are executed, tonight learn 2 characters of the players that voted today.
otherNightReminder: If executed today, wake and tell Executed 2 characters that voted on them today.

name: Not dead
ability: If you die, learn a dead character; If you are executed twice, you might be resurrected tonight.
otherNightReminder: If Not Dead dies, show them a dead characters token. If executed today for the 2nd time, Not dead might be resurrected.

name: Aiyamdrunk
ability: All other players are sobor & healthy. If you are "mad" about your character, townsfolk abilities yield false info, even if dead.

name: Not good
ability: Once per game, the Storyteller will announce that a mistake has been made, but it shouldn't affect the game's outcome.

name: Nominating Myself
ability: You might be resurrected at any time. You might die & might not die at any time.

name: Oneofthese Three
ability: You might register as your living neighbors characters & as an evil minion.

name: Mad
ability: You think you are a character not on this script but you are not. Your ability might work, if your team is losing.

name: New Player
ability: Each night choose a player; they are drunk tonight and tomorrow day.
firstNightReminder: Wake the player and have them choose a player. mark them as drunk for tonight and tomomrrow
otherNightReminder: Wake the player and have them choose a player. mark them as drunk for tonight and tomomrrow

name: Lying
ability: Players publicly 'mad' they are a character they are not might be executed. You register as good [+1 or -1 outsider]

name: Anything
ability: Each day you may visit the Storyteller to learn and gain a new ability and lose the previous.

name: In-Play
ability: Once per game you may publicly guess all players characters, if all good players characters are correct, your team wins.

name: Impish
ability: Each night* choose a player, they die. The first "new player" this kills becomes an evil Imp! and you die instead.
otherNightReminder: Wake the Impish and have them select a player. they die. If a "new player" was killed, the Impish dies instead and the new player becomes an evil "imp"

name: Regular Imp
ability: Each night* choose a player, they might die. The first time you die, a minion becomes Impish.
firstNightReminder: Wake the Regular Imp and have them select a player. the chosen player dies.

name: Not an Imp game
ability: Each night choose a player, they are poisioned. The previously poisioned player dies then becomes healthy.
firstNightReminder: Wake the player and have them select a player, They are poisioned.
otherNightReminder: Wake the player and have them select a player, they are poisioned. The previously poisioned player dies.

name: Imp!
ability: Each night* choose a player, they die. If you kill yourself this way, a minion becomes Regular Imp
otherNightReminder: Each night* select a player, they die. If the player kills themself, a minion becomes a Regular Imp.

name: Off Script
ability: You are an off-script character. You will learn which tonight.

name: Not on script
ability: You are a not on script character. You learn which tonight.

name: Double Claim
ability: You start knowing 2 secret words you cannot share. The first player of your alignment to publicly say a word you know, becomes a new traveler and you become their character.
otherNightReminder: If a word was spoken today, switch characters with the player who said a chosen word.

name: Makin' this up
ability: You don't know your ability or your task. Each day, privately ask 1 question about the task & receive a hint. If you completed your task, tonight you learn your ability.
otherNightReminder: If their task was completed. Makin' this up learns their ability.

name: No One
ability: Each night, gain a new traveler ability. A player of the same alignment learns which.
firstNightReminder: No One gains a new traveler ability of the Storytellers choice. Wake a player of their aglinment and show them which traveler they gain the ability of.
otherNightReminder: No One gains a new traveler ability of the Storytellers choice. Wake a player of their aglinment and show them which traveler they gain the ability of.

name: Leaving Shortly
ability: Players (not yourself) that call for your exile, die.
